findings.title: Do not treat every provider hole as an accounted-for session
findings.description: `not_caught_up_report` skips every `provider_hole` via `_LISTED_NEVER`, without checking the session’s `condition`. The exit criterion excludes only a provider hole on a missing day. A hole on another condition can therefore be omitted from the report and avoid an exit failure, allowing the cutover to pass with an unaccounted-for session. Only skip a provider hole when the coverage row confirms the missing-day condition; otherwise report and judge it.

findings.title: Include unheld jobs when deriving the 30-day ceiling
findings.description: `ceiling_values` derives the 30-day ceiling from `planned + trailing`, but the spend guard also counts unheld provider jobs toward that cap. The estimate summary exposes those jobs in `unheld_jobs`; when any are present, the printed command can still leave the guard refusing the purchase. Include their costs when deriving the suggested cap.

findings.title: Collect the health rows required by the evidence step
findings.description: The evidence collection reads and narrates accounting rows, but it does not collect the current health rows. `health_exit_code()` runs `mt data health` and returns only its exit code; that result is used for the baseline comparison, not included in the evidence. This leaves the required per-product health evidence absent from the narration.

findings.title: Attribute over-session names to the matching family
findings.description: `over_sessions` drops the volume check’s `family`, and `_family_evidence` groups the resulting names only by product. `over_failures` then uses that combined list for each family row with an `over` count. When multiple volume families have over sessions, a row can name sessions belonging to another family, making the evidence attribution incorrect. Preserve and filter by family when collecting and reporting those names.

structured_findings.summary: Do not treat every provider hole as an accounted-for session
Include unheld jobs when deriving the 30-day ceiling
Collect the health rows required by the evidence step
Attribute over-session names to the matching family
